reviews.t: Great solution to a discontinued product.
reviews.x: I have used the Windex Touch Up Pumps in my bathrooms for quick cleanups. Unfortunately, they discontinued the product and the pump bottles are not refillable. I was getting a pedicure recently and the cosmetologist used a bottle like this for nail polish remover. Lightbulb moment: I can fill them with windex and keep one in each bathroom to replace the touch up pumps that I used to buy. I have to fill these bottles more frequently but in the long run, they will save me money because they are re

I bought these to use to dispense mineral spirits and denatured alcohol in my woodworking shop. I figured that if they could be used with acetone nail polish remover, they would certainly hold up for the less volatile solutions above. In both cases, they worked the first time I used them on the first day. But the next day, both of them where frozen so that the pump would not spring back to allow the liquid to be dispensed. I couldn't even get them to pop back out by pulling on the pump pad.  Now

reviews.t: Perfect size and easy to use
reviews.x: Works well, looks nice on my vanity and exactly as advertised. I couldn't find these in the stores, Amazon had them and the price seemed pretty good for a pair.  Easy to use with one hand and the size is just right - I use them for storing/dispensing witch hazel and toner.

reviews.t: Great for nail stuff and face toners
reviews.x: These are perfect for alcohol and acetone for manicures, facial toners, etc. the only thing I’d say is be careful with certain chemicals because the bottle I have with acetone seems to be breaking down a bit compared to the one with rubbing alcohol. I think the plastics used just don’t work the best with pure acetone, but everything else I’ve put in it has worked great and hasn’t leaked at all.

reviews.t: Useful for non-beauty related applications, too
reviews.x: No one in my family uses nail polish (on actual fingernails--we have a few bottles as ad hoc varnish/threadlock), but we've found these bottles quite useful to dispense iso alcohol during crafting/electronic repair projects, especially when we're working with resin and have hands covered in gunk. Having the pump bottles on the desk, we can grab paper towels/cotton pads with our gunky hands and dispense some cleaner without having to spread the gunk. These are plastic, so they're a bit light, but
I use these for witch hazel in the bathrooms.  It makes it easy to dispense and I would say it reduces waste.  Usually only need two pumps per cotton round. Would recommend.

I’m using this for my Micellar water and it’s really easy to use!! I can get my cotton pad wet without pouring the product everywhere saving me time from cleanup and money because I’m not wasting product. I bought the smaller size first to try it out and then bought the 2 pack of this size because it holds a whole bottle of travel size product and a good amount from a larger bottle. I definitely recommend this!!!

I got this bc I purchased a large bottle of micellar water and wanted a dispenser to apply morning and night.  I use cotton rounds and push down on the pump to apply to the round.  Since it came with 2 I gave one to my daughter for the same purpose.  Works great, would buy again.

After containing Mineral Fusion nail polish remover (one of the most popular, most effective removers on the market), this bottle stopped dispensing as well as it had. Upon inspection, we realized the acetone had started warping the all the parts so that the lid wouldn't totally close anymore, too much acetone started coming out per pump, and, most dangerously of all, the bottle itself had begun warping and starring. What's happening is it is liquifying the plastic and causing it to become molte

These were great for the first several months, but one stopped working completely and the other partially works. I use these once a day at night for my facial cleanser (miceller water) and toner (so nothing too thick or chemically that would damage the plastic). I also wished they dispensed at least double the amount, I have to dispense 3-4 times at least to get my little cotton rounds moist enough to actually use on my face. They were okay for what I used them for, but I’m now looking for a bet

Previously I have used Windex Touch-Up for spot cleaning the kitchen counters, table, etc.  I really liked it, but it was never carried in very many stores.  Then, due to the Covid-19 pandemic, I have been unable to purchase it at all.  So I found these pump bottles, filled them with cleaner, and made my own product.  It works very well, and is much less expensive.

These great dispensers are pretty and work perfectly.  Water tight lids are perfect for watery liquids. If there is any leftover liquid after dispensing,  it slowly drips back into the bottle.  I use these for witch hazel, however, I would not recommend for use with Creams and lotions.

reviews.t: Looks great. Pumps well. Probably not best for nail polish remover.
reviews.x: I received two of these. They both pump as expected and look premium.  I put a bottle of non-acetone nail polish remover in one and the base and the neck has turned a cloudy white color. It still pumps well and hasn’t distorted the bottle at all, it just looks a little sad!

reviews.t: Not a good match for acetone
reviews.x: I bought this to use with 100% acetone nail polish remover. The first problem was that one pump was insufficient to soak a cotton swab enough to take off polish, but a second pump would cause the acetone to spurt all over. This lead to a second problem, which was the spilled acetone would then drop down the outside of the bottle and stain/cloud it. Ultimately, I replaced this with a glass bottle with a steel pump.

Loves these bottles! They are so convenient. I have eye makeup remover in one and rubbing alcohol in another.  I keep them in separate spots, but I should probably add some labels so I don’t get them confused. I purchased a second set for my daughter.

Thought I could use acetone in this but after just a couple hours I could tell it wasn’t the right kind of plastic for the harshness of pure acetone. Totally my fault. I use it now for my witch hazel and make up remover.
Filled with isopropyl alcohol. First time I used it, I mashed on it with a cotton ball and got what you might expect.. a mess. Easy does it and make sure you snap the lid closed. Recommended.
I bought these to put makeup remove and toner in. They’re pretty big and make it super convenient to get product out. They look really nice on my counter and work great.
I ordered these for my mom (who had a stroke) to keep rubbing alcohol in. They work perfectly and she can easily use them with one hand. I’m super happy with them!
I would prefer glass bottles (these are plastic), but they dispense my face cleanser and eye makeup remover perfectly.  Just what I needed.
I really wanted this to worn out. The pump didn’t work the first time. Reordered and the pumps didn’t work after a few times use.
Holds acetone without affecting the structure of the bottle, but acetone will warp the plastic
Bought for my facial water.  I love them, I only needed one but a back up is always a bonus
One bottle works the second did not and they don’t accept returns or exchange
Don’t use this for acetone. The bottle will start to warp and turn cloudy

claims.text: Many reviewers find these dispensers convenient and easy to use for products like micellar water, witch hazel, and toner, appreciating that they reduce waste and allow one-handed pumping.
Several reviewers report the plastic breaks down, warps, or turns cloudy when used with acetone or nail polish remover.
Some reviewers use them successfully for non-beauty liquids like rubbing alcohol and isopropyl alcohol in crafting or repair projects.
A few reviewers report durability problems, with pumps stopping working or dispensing poorly after several months of use.
Some reviewers note the pumps dispense too little per press or can spurt liquid, and advise against thick creams and lotions.
